create_object_config_instance: create an ObjectConfig instance with a name string and a config dictionary
access_object_config_name: access the name attribute of an ObjectConfig instance to get the object name
access_object_config_config: access the config attribute of an ObjectConfig instance to get the configuration dictionary
modify_object_config_config: modify the config dictionary of an ObjectConfig instance to update object settings
serialize_object_config: serialize an ObjectConfig instance to a dictionary for storage or transmission
